glosses: government employee, (government) official, civil servant, public servant, (police) officer (male or of unspecified gender)

examples.text: Der Beamte gestand mir seinen Fehler.
examples.en: The clerk admitted his mistake to me.

examples.text: In manchen Staaten sind Richter gewählte Beamte.
examples.en: In some states, judges are elected officials.

examples.text: Der Beamte konnte die Beschwerde nicht selbst bearbeiten.
examples.en: The official could not deal with the complaint himself.
